title: Mute mode, Drop, and a steadier screen
thisBuild: MUTE on the dock: hold it and tap pads to mute or unmute them; let go and the pads play again. Tap MUTE instead and it stays on until you tap it again. Muted pads go dark with a slash, and every pad gets a red rim while Mute is on.
Hold a bank number (1 to 4) for half a second: the whole bank mutes, or comes back.
DROP on the dock: hold it and everything goes quiet but the pads you touch. Let go and it all comes back.
The wall of mute keys under LOOP is gone. LOOP is back to one row of loops.
HotKeys: Mute is a swipe choice now, and the same swipe again closes whatever it opened (Edit tray, Padiano, FX).

For the lag and crackle: the screen runs at 60 a second unless you turn on Settings, Playing, Screen: smooth. The beat glow no longer redraws the whole screen on every frame. The Latency screen now says whether Android gave the sound its fast path, and how the screen is keeping up.
watch: Play the same thing as in your video for five minutes: open Latency after. How many dropouts, and what does Fast audio path say?
Mute mode: hold MUTE and tap pads while the loop plays. Quick enough?
Drop on a fill, then let go on the one.
limits: This build is the first half of the lag work. The deeper fix (moving the sound onto Android's newer fast audio system) is in the proposal doc waiting for your call.
Drop leaves sounds that are already ringing to finish; it stops new hits.
Muting a sound mutes it on every pad that has it.
